name: gpg
description: GNU Privacy Guard suite for encryption, digital signatures, and key management

gpg.description: GNU Privacy Guard for encryption, digital signatures, and key management
gpg.usage:
gpg --gen-key # Generate new key pair
gpg --encrypt -r recipient@email.com file.txt # Encrypt file
gpg --decrypt file.txt.gpg # Decrypt file
gpg --sign document.pdf # Create digital signature
gpg --verify signature.sig file.txt # Verify signature

gpg-agent.description: GnuPG private key agent for secure key management and caching
gpg-agent.usage: gpg-agent --daemon # Start agent daemon\ngpg-agent --reload # Reload configuration\necho RELOADAGENT | gpg-connect-agent # Reload via socket

dirmngr.description: GnuPG keyserver and certificate manager daemon
dirmngr.usage: dirmngr --server # Start keyserver daemon\ndirmngr --list-crls # List certificate revocation lists\ndirmngr --lookup-cert email@example.com # Look up certificate

gpg-connect-agent.description: GnuPG agent communication tool for daemon control and key operations
gpg-connect-agent.usage: gpg-connect-agent # Interactive agent communication\necho 'KEYINFO --list' | gpg-connect-agent # List loaded keys\necho '/bye' | gpg-connect-agent # Close connection

gpgconf.description: GnuPG configuration management and component control utility
gpgconf.usage:
gpgconf --list-components # List GnuPG components
gpgconf --reload gpg-agent # Reload specific component
gpgconf --list-options gpg # Show GPG options
gpgconf --change-options gpg # Modify configuration
